orderConfirmation.title: Order received
orderConfirmation.body: Thank you — ORA has received your order details.
orderConfirmation.missingReference: We couldn't find an order reference. If you just submitted an order, please check your details and try again.

hero.headline: Scrubs, made to your measurements.
hero.subheadline: Every ORA scrub is cut to your own measurements and finished in the color you choose.

value.heading: Made for the people who wear it every day.
value.body: Doctors and nurses spend long hours in their scrubs. ORA builds each piece around your measurements and the color you request, so it fits the way you work and looks the way you want to be seen.

showcase.heading: The ORA look.
showcase.body: A closer look at ORA's scrub silhouettes.
showcase.note: Every piece is available in a custom color you choose yourself — more on that below.

customization.heading: Designed around you.
customization.body: Choose your shape, request any color by sending a reference image, and add any details you'd like your tailor to know.

points.shape: Choose your scrub shape and style
points.color: Send a reference image for your exact color — not limited to a fixed list
points.details: Add any additional modifications or details

one.title: Share your details
one.body: Submit your measurements and customization details.

two.title: Upload your references
two.body: Provide your required reference and payment images.

three.title: ORA reviews your request
three.body: We check your details before confirming.

four.title: Order confirmed
four.body: Your order is confirmed and processed.

finalCta.heading: Ready for scrubs made your way?

intro.heading: Start your order
intro.body: Share your measurements and customization details below. ORA will review your request before confirming the order.

errors.phone: Please enter a valid mobile number.
errors.phoneEg: An Egyptian mobile number is 11 digits (e.g. 01012345678), or 10 without the leading zero.
errors.fileType: Only JPG, PNG or WEBP images are accepted.
errors.fileSize: The image must be smaller than {value}MB.
errors.tooManyFiles: You can upload up to {value} images.

customer.title: Customer information
customer.description: How we'll identify your order and reach you.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.description: All measurements in centimeters. If a tailor has already taken your measurements, you can upload photos of them below.

customization.title: Scrub customization
customization.description: Tell us the shape and color you'd like. Color is not limited to a fixed list — upload a reference image showing the exact color you want.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: The full scrub value is paid in advance. A payment screenshot is required to confirm your order.

mobileNumber.label: Mobile number
mobileNumber.hint: Choose your country, then type the number without the country code.

address.label: Detailed address
address.hint: Street, building, floor, and any landmarks that help with delivery.

referencePhotos.label: Tailor measurement photos
referencePhotos.hint: Optional photos showing measurements taken by a tailor. Up to 4 images.

shape.label: Scrub shape / model / design
shape.hint: Describe the shape, cut, or style you'd like.

colorDescription.label: Color description
colorDescription.hint: Optional — describe the color in your own words in addition to the reference image.

colorReferenceImage.label: Color reference image
colorReferenceImage.hint: Required — upload an image showing the exact color you want.

additionalDetails.label: Additional details
additionalDetails.hint: Any other modifications or notes for your tailor.

designReferenceImages.label: Design reference images
designReferenceImages.hint: Optional — up to 4 images showing the model, design, or modifications you'd like.

screenshot.label: Payment screenshot
screenshot.hint: Required — kept separate from your design and reference images.

upload.tooLarge: {fileName} is larger than 5MB and wasn't added.
upload.wrongType: {fileName} isn't a supported image type and wasn't added.
upload.tooMany: You can upload up to {max} images.

submit.validationSummary: Some details need fixing — the fields in red below show what.
submit.networkError: We couldn't reach ORA. Please check your internet connection and try again — your details are still here.
submit.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
submit.serverError: Something went wrong on our side and your order wasn't sent. Please try again in a moment.
